paper.title_en: Thermodynamic phase transition, pairing symmetry and Fermi surface topology in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate films
paper.abstract_en: Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates provide an uncharted territory to explore high-transition-temperature (high-$T_C$) superconductivity and superconducting mechanism. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of a new type of high-$T_C$ superconducting RP nickelate heterostructure $\mathrm{La_2PrNi_2O_7/NdAlO_3}$ by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. A superconducting state is observed without a pseudogap state, enabling a direct measurement of the superconducting order parameter and a microscopic extraction of the electronic specific heat. The observed superconducting gap opens at $T_C$ with prominent coherence peaks, illustrating the emergence of nonzero order parameter upon entering the superconducting state. An electronic specific heat jump appears at $T_C$, further demonstrating a thermodynamic phase transition. The magnitude of the superconducting order parameter is quantified by the observed superconducting coherence peaks, and a nodeless behavior is unambiguously established in the absence of pseudogap. The underlying Fermi surface consists of $α$, $β$ and $γ$ pockets, exhibiting a multi-orbital nature. Strain dependent measurements further reveal the $γ$ pocket in all superconducting and non-superconducting films with different epitaxial strain. Our results establish the missing thermodynamic evidence for superconducting phase transition in nickelates. They also provide direct evidence for the symmetry of the superconducting order parameter and illustrate the relationship between Fermi surface topology and the emergence of superconductivity in RP nickelate films.

decision.title_zh: Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐薄膜中的热力学相变、配对对称性和费米面拓扑
decision.abstract_zh: Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) 镍酸盐提供了一个未开发的领域来探索高转变温度 (高-$T_C$) 超导性和超导机制。在这里，我们通过角分辨光电子能谱研究了一种新型高-$T_C$ 超导 RP 镍酸盐异质结构 $\mathrm{La_2PrNi_2O_7/NdAlO_3}$ 的电子结构。观察到没有赝能隙态的超导态，从而能够直接测量超导序参量并微观提取电子比热。观测到的超导能隙在 $T_C$ 处打开并带有显著的相干峰，说明了进入超导态时非零序参量的出现。电子比热跃变出现在 $T_C$ 处，进一步证明了热力学相变。超导序参量的大小通过观测到的超导相干峰进行量化，并且在没有赝能隙的情况下明确建立了无节点行为。底层费米面由 $α$、$β$ 和 $γ$ 口袋组成，表现出多轨道性质。应变依赖的测量进一步揭示了在不同外延应变的所有超导和非超导薄膜中 $γ$ 口袋的存在。我们的结果确立了镍酸盐中超导相变缺失的热力学证据。它们还为超导序参量的对称性提供了直接证据，并说明了 RP 镍酸盐薄膜中费米面拓扑与超导性出现之间的关系。
